prior_threads.reason: The map's locations are now mostly identified, the map is traced back to Bral (beat_59), and Grimny says the hoard was probably hidden in the Dragon's Lair (beat_60). That redirects the search, though the treasure is not yet found.

The party gained Sir Brandon's sword, a faun-wine plan, the lair's location and the help of Lady Hilda and Malzazarik. The dragon is still alive and unconfronted, and Dunk's doubt that it exists is only speculation.

The deal was renegotiated: the goblins now settle the upper mound and wall off the stairs instead of inhabiting the whole mound (beat_10). Wayman also promised Snurk never to reveal them to King Hogboon (beat_12), which remains owed.
Sir Alfred was incapacitated but deliberately left undestroyed (beat_7), and the goblins are walling off the stairs. He remains a danger, and why he roams the mound is still unknown.
Cedric and Warwick tie the stopped shipments to the dragon troubles (beat_19, beat_21), partly answering the question.

Ingrid learned that Warwick knows of her night visits and is not interested (beat_44), and she left crestfallen, blaming Dunk. Dunk's promise to help her was never released, so the thread stays open in a changed shape.
Not touched this Session; the penance and donation are still owed.
The party brought out its first treasure (beat_13) and sold it to Cedric (beat_20). Squints' promised second pick was neither given nor released.

new_threads.name: Robes for Brother Dirk
new_threads.reason: Dr. Uriah promised to return the barrow robes to the church once the dragon is defeated (beat_18), and that is still owed. The thread serves the church's claim, not the hunt.

new_threads.name: Cedric's promissory note
new_threads.reason: Cedric owes 975 gold once the caravans flow again, and the note was used to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda (beat_47). Payment remains outstanding.

new_threads.name: The Warwick deal
new_threads.reason: This is one bargain with several sides: Warwick plays the lyre to ward off his night visitors and lends the mithril shirt for the mine (beat_25, beat_26), holding the lyre and plate as collateral. In return the party owes him metal and the shirt's return. The mine's cave-in still stands in the way.

new_threads.name: Protection against the dragon's poison
new_threads.reason: Sir Phidipaldi stated that anti-poison remedies are needed because the party is hunting the dragon (beat_28). Neither Ingrid nor Vivian could supply them (beat_39), so protection is still wanted.

new_threads.name: Vivian's message to Grimny
new_threads.reason: Vivian's letter and scent were delivered to Grimny's ghost (beat_62), who departed elated (beat_64). Nothing more was owed.

new_threads.name: Dunk's dwarven ring
new_threads.reason: Dunk wears a magical ring that let him speak with Grimny's ghost, and whether it is cursed is still unknown (beat_53). What it does now that Grimny has gone is also unclear.

new_threads.name: Who killed Grimny
new_threads.reason: Grimny believes his brother Bral murdered him (beat_56), and Bral is the dwarf who gave the party its map. The killing stands as its own open question about Bral.
